name: Gekkomon
main_effect: [When Moving] [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Among them, add 1 [Glowing Dawn] trait card to the hand and place 1 such card face down under any of your [Glowing Dawn] trait Tamers. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
source_effect: ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, it checks security before the attack ends.)
